observations: Three photos show a black tufted sofa with gold-colored legs.
The sofa has a rounded back and armrests, with a quilted design on the back and seat.
The upholstery appears to be a dark fabric, possibly velvet or a similar material.
The gold legs are thin and tapered, visible at the base of the sofa.
No visible brand or model markings are present on the sofa in any photo.
The photos are taken in a well-lit indoor setting with tiled flooring.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'OLANIYI OLAMIDE' are overlaid on all photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show only one sofa, but the seller claims both 3-seater and 2-seater versions. No visual evidence confirms the presence of both.

risks.risk: The sofa may be damaged or have hidden wear not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the upholstery, especially the seams and edges, and a shot of the underside of the sofa.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or worn, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The sofa may not be in working condition (e.g., broken springs, loose joints).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the sofa being pushed or shaken to test stability and cushioning.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: The sofa may have been previously used for pets or have stains not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the seat and backrest, especially under the tufting, to check for dirt or stains.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially stained or dirty, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
A photo or video showing the underside of the sofa to check for damage or wear.
A close-up of the upholstery, especially under the tufting, to check for stains or dirt.
A video showing the sofa being pushed or shaken to test stability and cushioning.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
